result: No new locomotion candidate passed the complete acceptance test; retain C04 and keep experimental modes off. PD/Q/R unchanged. Execution-boundary software implementations and diagnostics are available, but delayed inner-PD peak and full-motion stability are not both resolved.

implemented.signed_inner_pd_window: Signed PD extrema and nominal PD in WBC dynamics and total-torque inequalities; independent FF bound; conditional on assumed acceleration. H0 retains legacy behavior.
implemented.host_total_torque: Opt-in WBC total request; same-sample decomposition/recomposition after handoff; motor gains0; raw/sent/scale recorded. Initial stand total latched once; short QP failure holds last bounded total. It changes actuator feedback placement.
implemented.joint_reference: Opt-in direct nominal q/dq from the same active primal solution/time; feedback contact forces retained; dq-only slew bypassed together. It does not provide cross-policy C1 continuity.
implemented.swing_reference: Independent optional swing-only absolute height correction and flat foot-center plane; stance constraint/global positionErrorGain unchanged. G20/.026 tested only in copied profiles.
implemented.retired_experiments: Failed paired joint filter, phase-only slew exception, lookahead and dead PD-fraction option removed; historical trace prefix reserved.

findings: Contact acceleration exceeded the A100rad/s2 window assumption and actual signed PD left its predicted envelope; no stale packet window is needed for failure. This is not a strict physical torque guarantee.
Exact nominal reference sampling fixes the nominal-state/feedback-input source mismatch, but does not by itself stabilize motion or eliminate policy replacement jumps.

G20 with .026m foot-center plane produced roughly9-10.3cm complete swing peaks under the legacy H0 actuator case, yet still tripped effort protection at5.474/5.216s. Other actuator formulations did not retain that clearance result.

Unlatched host handoff delayed the high-gain standing PD and failed before TROT. Latching the initial total allowed initial stance; TROT still failed tilt acceptance. Fixed command amplitude alone is insufficient.
Retained C04 passed fresh-world +/-0.5m/s, each20s TROT plus30s final stance soak. This does not establish1m/s or hardware acceptance.

tests.baseline_binary_note: The C04 run used the cleaned binary before the final host-only handoff fix. That fix is gated by host_total_torque_command=false in C04; the final binary was used for the latched-host regression and26/26CTest.

latched_host_boundary_evidence.scope: 500Hz controller exports and sampled simulator request effort before the first100Hz independent tilt crossing. Startup may still hold earlier queued stand-PD packets. Not measured physical torque or a complete20s motion test.

limitations: Simulation request effort is raw FF+PD and is applied before separate passive friction; real reported effort semantics and firmware combined limiting are unidentified.
Host fixed effort bounds the transmitted software request, not physical torque, current, thermal duty or transmission efficiency.
No hardware stand-up/walking; no new gain scan before stable execution/reference regression.
All cases retained the existing acceptance bounds, nominal torque limits,20ms simulated command delay,100Hz IMU,500Hz control and50Hz NMPC. Experimental speed ceilings were isolated copies.
Ignored raw logs/source snapshots and per-run runner snapshots remain local; this report embeds compact results for review.
